name.x-prompt: What should be the name of the selector?

path.description: The path to create the selectors.

skipTests.description: When true, does not create test files.

flat.description: When true (the default), creates the files in the path directly; when false, creates them in a folder named after the selector.

group.description: When true, creates the selector files within a selectors folder.

feature.description: When true, selects the state of the reducer the feature schematic creates (typed by its State); without it, the feature state is typed unknown.
